methodBoundary: HD1 residual names were withheld from HD2 Pass A source collection and Pass B coding. This file was created only after the HD2 history and primary theory coding were frozen. Counts are descriptive recurrence evidence, not theory scores.

clusters.name: Complementarity / co-production
clusters.hd2Reading: The 1830–1869 cases again separate a core mechanism from materials, instruments, operator skill, finance, law, infrastructure, demand and labor that make consequence possible. Atlantic cable and transcontinental rail are particularly strong system cases.

clusters.name: Validation → diffusion / durable-service latency
clusters.hd2Reading: HD2 strengthens this cluster by adding lifecycle time: first signal, first operation or first publication can be real while durable service/adoption remains absent. 1858 Atlantic cable and the withdrawn/restored storm-warning service are clean cases.

clusters.name: Instrumentation / observability leverage
clusters.hd2Reading: Mirror galvanometers, calorimetry/thermometry, anesthesia delivery, maps/records, spectroscopes, telegraphed observations and controlled cultures repeatedly change what can be discriminated rather than merely making an old answer faster.

clusters.name: Standards / representation as coordination substrate
clusters.hd2Reading: Rail gauge, international telegraph regulations, screw threads, atomic weights, decision-grade records and stable experimental treatment/sample identities all reduce future coordination or comparison cost without themselves being the physical end product.

clusters.name: Distributed invention / priority compression
clusters.hd2Reading: The period repeatedly produces near-independent routes, priority collisions and complementary implementation roles. Later single-name stories compress a network that source-native reconstruction re-expands.

clusters.name: Scale-induced boundary shift / externality
clusters.hd2Reading: Scaling transport, fertilizer/resource extraction and industrial production changes who bears costs and what the relevant objective is. Labor, land, sovereignty and environmental consequences move inside the causal boundary at system scale.

clusters.name: Institutional continuity / effective enactment
clusters.hd2Reading: Funding, law, convention, inspection, patent pools and durable institutions repeatedly determine whether a technically known capability becomes effective. The 1848 Public Health Act and 1842 mine law make formal rule versus implementation especially visible.

clusters.name: Local versus general / metaproductive optimality
clusters.hd2Reading: No globally best route is implied by a more reusable or sophisticated design. Daguerre/calotype/collodion trade different objectives; Bessemer/open-hearth depend on feedstock/control; atmospheric rail can work yet lose lifecycle economics; Great Eastern can fail its original market and later be unusually valuable for cable laying.

hd2NewResiduals.name: Temporal durability is a distinct validation axis
hd2NewResiduals.claim: A capability can pass an initial trial or enter service while failing weeks/months later, or be withdrawn and later reinstated. Validation therefore has a temporal/lifecycle dimension distinct from cross-environment generalization.
hd2NewResiduals.relationToExisting: Potential refinement/substructure of R2 and frozen S3, not a new prior yet.

hd2NewResiduals.name: Latent option value after declared-objective failure
hd2NewResiduals.claim: An artifact/project can fail or underperform its original objective yet retain reusable capability or evidence that becomes valuable under a later problem: Great Eastern→cable laying, failed quinine synthesis→mauveine, preserved samples→future analyses.
hd2NewResiduals.relationToExisting: Related to R8/metaproductivity but distinct enough to track as an objective-migration/option-value residual.

hd2NewResiduals.name: Useful intervention can precede correct causal ontology
hd2NewResiduals.claim: A partially wrong or incomplete causal model can still support useful interventions or representations, while later evidence changes mechanism without erasing the earlier empirical effect.
hd2NewResiduals.relationToExisting: Touches S1/S8/S10 and HD1 individual productive-partial-model cases, but was not a promoted HD1 residual cluster.
hd2NewResiduals.promotion: NO — one epoch as named cluster.

campaignGate: No residual is promoted before recurrence across at least three epochs and at least three materially different domains, followed by HD9 review. R1–R8 now have two-epoch recurrence and therefore become higher-priority observations for HD3, not theory changes.
worldModelReading: All eight HD1 residual clusters recur in HD2 under independently collected history. That is stronger evidence of low-dimensional recurring pressures than a high retrospective SUPPORTS count, because the residual names were withheld until after HD2 source lock and Pass B. Still, two epochs are insufficient for promotion.
